name: Aerobic Spin Reactivation
focus: Restart the aerobic engine, easy and consistent

steps.description: Z1 easy spin, build gradually, cadence 85-90 rpm
Low Z2 aerobic, HR 146-155 bpm, cadence 85-90 rpm
Z1 easy spin down, HR dropping below 145 bpm

name: Easy Aerobic Run
focus: Weekly running stimulus, aerobic base, leg turnover

steps.description: Z1 recovery jog, <145 bpm, genuinely easy
Z2 aerobic, 146-162 bpm — if HR exceeds 162 slow the pace
Z1 walk/jog, shake the legs out

name: Sweet-Spot Intro
focus: First structured effort — sweet-spot stimulus, sub-threshold

steps.description: Gradual build from Z1 to low Z2, cadence 85-90 rpm
Z3 sweet-spot, 163-172 bpm, comfortably hard, short sentences only
Easy spin Z1, HR dropping, recover fully before next rep
Easy spin down, HR below 145 before stopping

name: Active Recovery Spin
focus: Flush the legs, keep movement, add zero fatigue

steps.description: Very easy, just get the legs moving
Z1 recovery, HR strictly under 145 bpm, cadence 80-85 rpm

name: Lower Body and Core
focus: Leg strength, posterior chain, core stability — shoulder fully unloaded
notes: 2 rounds: 12x goblet squat 16kg, 10x Romanian deadlift 22kg, 10 each leg reverse lunge bodyweight, 20x banded glute bridge, 8 each side dead bug, 40s plank. 45-60s rest between exercises, 90s between rounds. No shoulder loading this week.

steps.description: Leg swings forward and lateral 10 each, hip circles, 10 bodyweight squats, 10 glute bridges — slow and deliberate
2 rounds of main circuit: goblet squat, Romanian deadlift, reverse lunge, banded glute bridge, dead bug, plank
Hip flexor stretch 60s each side, figure-4 glute stretch, hamstring stretch — slow breathing into each position

name: Longer Aerobic Ride
focus: Build aerobic volume, metabolic base, fat-burning Z2 stimulus

steps.description: Z1 gradual build, start easy, finish top of Z1, cadence 85-90 rpm
Z2 aerobic, 146-162 bpm, cadence 85-92 rpm — if HR exceeds 162 reduce watts by 10W
Z1 gradual spin down, HR back under 140 before stopping
